purchase_v2_projection_check.name: purchase_v2_projection_check
purchase_v2_projection_check.value: "event"."metadata"->>'schemaVersion'<>'2' OR COALESCE("event"."metadata"->>'source'='api' AND "event"."metadata"->>'orderId'="event"."business_key" AND ("event"."metadata"->>'orderAmountMinor')::bigint>0 AND "event"."metadata"->>'currency'="event"."metadata"#>>'{referralSnapshot,pricing,currency}' AND "event"."metadata"->>'orderAmountMinor'="event"."metadata"#>>'{referralSnapshot,pricing,payableAmountMinor}' AND "event"."metadata"#>>'{referralSnapshot,schemaVersion}'='1' AND "event"."metadata"#>>'{referralSnapshot,calculationVersion}'='1' AND "event"."metadata"#>>'{referralSnapshot,attribution,productId}'="event"."product_id" AND "event"."metadata"#>>'{referralSnapshot,attribution,programId}'="event"."program_id" AND "event"."participant_id" IS NOT NULL AND "event"."referral_id" IS NOT NULL AND "event"."occurred_at" IS NOT NULL,false)

participant_verified_ownership_check.name: participant_verified_ownership_check
participant_verified_ownership_check.value: ("participant"."owner_user_id" IS NULL AND "participant"."ownership_verified_by" IS NULL AND "participant"."ownership_verified_at" IS NULL AND "participant"."ownership_evidence" IS NULL AND "participant"."payout_recipient" IS NULL) OR ("participant"."owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "participant"."ownership_verified_by" IS NOT NULL AND "participant"."ownership_verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND ("participant"."ownership_evidence" IS NULL OR length("participant"."ownership_evidence")>0) AND ("participant"."payout_recipient" IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof("participant"."payout_recipient")='object'))

payout_completed_fields_check.name: payout_completed_fields_check
payout_completed_fields_check.value: "payout"."status"<>'completed' OR ("payout"."assigned_to" IS NOT NULL AND "payout"."confirmed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "payout"."execution_method" IS NOT NULL AND "payout"."provider" IS NOT NULL AND "payout"."execution_namespace" IS NOT NULL AND "payout"."external_reference" IS NOT NULL AND "payout"."confirmation_key" IS NOT NULL AND "payout"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

payout_processing_actor_check.name: payout_processing_actor_check
payout_processing_actor_check.value: "payout"."status" NOT IN ('processing','completed') OR "payout"."assigned_to" IS NOT NULL

referral_code_pair_check.name: referral_code_pair_check
referral_code_pair_check.value: ("referral"."refcode_id" IS NULL)=("referral"."applied_code" IS NULL) AND ("referral"."refcode_id" IS NULL OR ("referral"."product_id" IS NOT NULL AND "referral"."program_id" IS NOT NULL))
